skills.summary: Decides whether instruction addresses a performance problem before a course is designed, separating knowledge and practice gaps from tools, process, access, feedback, expectations and incentives.
triggers: A request for training, a course, a workshop or onboarding to fix a performance problem
A request for a needs assessment, performance analysis, or audience and task analysis
Do we need training for this?
boundaries: Doesn't design the course once training is indicated
Doesn't diagnose individuals or infer medical, psychological or learning-style traits
Doesn't contact performers, managers or clients
inputs: Case JSON: problem, audience, task with steps, sourced evidence per diagnostic question, optional requested_solution
prerequisites: Evidence from observation, logs, work samples or interviews held by a human owner
method: State the discrepancy as observed against expected performance
Fill the audience and task analysis; list what's missing
Answer diagnostic questions only from named sources
Report remedies with owners; say plainly when a requested course is not recommended
stopping_conditions: A route or no-gap-found is decided
Evidence is missing: return the questions instead of a route
Input is invalid: fix the case file
skills.output_contract: JSON with status (route, no-gap-found, collect-evidence), course_indicated (true, false, null), remedies with reason codes and sources, open questions, not_recommended, notes, warnings and audience_task_analysis with analysis_gaps. Exit 0 route, 1 collect-evidence, 2 invalid.
failure_states: Unsourced evidence is treated as missing and the route becomes collect-evidence
Self-report for the skill question is recorded as missing
Requester insists on a ruled-out course: route and requester decision reported separately

references.version: 3rd edition, 1997 (from author knowledge; not verified live on 2026-11-25)
references.rights: Copyrighted book; method paraphrased as questions, no text copied

skills.missing_capability: Without sourced evidence, return the diagnostic questions with status collect-evidence and stop at the human-data boundary; never guess a route.

skills.summary: Trainer-of-trainers procedures (design rationale, modeled examples with decision points, observation and feedback, rubric calibration, fading support, coaching another trainer, transfer evaluation), plus teacher-education and educator professional-learning modes, with scripts that refuse invented agreement and invented results.
triggers: Facilitation guide, rubric calibration or norming, inter-rater agreement
Teacher professional-learning plan, methods-course module, microteaching, observation instrument or coaching cycle
How do we show the training worked?
boundaries: Doesn't decide whether training is the remedy (edu-needs-analysis does)
Doesn't grade, place, certify or evaluate a person; human supervisors decide
Doesn't invent observations, ratings, survey results or learning gains
inputs: Learner task and a needs analysis showing a skill gap
Rubric or the task to write one
Named human owners: coach, reviewers, data collector
For teacher-education modules: business task, computing practice and answer key
prerequisites: edu-needs-analysis result showing a skill gap
method: Model a complete example with numbered decision points
Plan observation with a focus list and the feedback pattern
Run calibration with generated practice anchors; compute agreement only from real human ratings
Coach another trainer through an adaptation exercise
stopping_conditions: A finding: fix the package without dropping required sections
Real data needed: hand the plan to the named human owner
skills.output_contract: agreement.py stats prints computed per-pair agreement or practice-only with discussion items; evidence_plan.py check prints accepted or rejected with findings and warnings; package.py check prints complete or incomplete with findings, calibration status, evidence-plan status and, for teacher modules, evidence-line statuses. Exit 0 ok, 1 refused or findings, 2 invalid.
failure_states: Generated or synthetic ratings: practice-only, no agreement figure
Fewer than 10 shared items: figure labeled a calibration signal
Survey, attendance, completion, self-report or generated-artifact-only plan: rejected
Synthetic package with observation records or merged evidence lines: incomplete
